description.zh:
数据库对象数组。
> 最大数据库数10个，数据库账号数10个。允许不传账号，不传账号则代表授权到数据库。
description.en:
An array that consists of database objects.

> You can specify up to 10 databases and 10 database accounts. The database accounts are not required. If you do not specify a database account, the user is authorized to manage only the databases.

description.zh:
指定要授权数据库和数据库账户的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host whose user you want to grant permissions.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
要授权的用户ID。
> 您可以调用[ListUsers](~~204522~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the user to be authorized.

> You can call the [ListUsers](~~204522~~) operation to query the user ID.

title.zh: 为用户授权数据库及数据库账户

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-database-accounts-to-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-wwo36qbv601 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --databases '[{"DatabaseId":"22","DatabaseAccountIds":["1"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
